{{Quote|You must walk the path of Revan on your own. The path to power&mdash;the path neither Jedi nor Sith.|Tari Darkspanner|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Order of Revan''', also known as the '''Revanites''', was a secret society within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that adhered to the teaching of the powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Balancing the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Order sought to change the Empire from within, and they accepted members from all levels of Imperial society and even [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], just as Revan had done. The Order was founded by [[Tari Darkspanner]], who discovered records of Revan on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] while training to be [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the Empire's [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the Order was headquartered in a [[Revanite compound|compound]] in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, Revan himself took control of the Order during the [[Galactic War]] and transformed it into a fanatical cult with members in the upper echelons of both the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

==History==
{{Quote|We learn from those who come before us and gain strength from their triumphs and failures. As a Jedi, Revan was a warrior who slaughtered armies. As a Sith, Revan was a teacher who trained a thousand dark apprentices. Eventually, Jedi and Sith both turned on Revan. But instead of being destroyed, Revan was reborn.|Dzoun|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Revanites.png|left|thumb|Revanites on Dromund Kaas]]
[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tari Darkspanner]] stumbled across records of the ancient [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], a man who had been both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] almost three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier, while she was training to become a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. During her explorations, Darkspanner learned how Revan and his allies had [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|confronted]] the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], and she came to believe that Revan had in fact emerged victorious&mdash;and that it was he, and not the Emperor, who sat on the throne of the Empire. She soon founded the Order of Revan, which recruited members of all [[Species/Legends|species]] and walks of life from across the Empire. Devoting themselves to Revan's teachings, the Order sought to bring the Empire into balance between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides of the Force]]&mdash;the ways of peace and war&mdash;from within.<ref name="Pilgrimage" />

Growing to be several hundred members strong, the Order&mdash;whose members became known as Revanites&mdash;began to attract scrutiny from the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], who sought to stamp out their heretical teachings. This forced the Order to cease their meetings in the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and retreat into the jungles of Dromund Kaas. There, they established a [[Revanite compound|compound]]<ref name="Revanite Compound" /> that was located near a [[Revanite Shrine|cave]] in which the Order maintained a shrine to Revan.<ref name="Death and Life" /> Some Revanites devoted their entire lives to the Order's teachings and excluded themselves from Imperial society, while others met in secret and maintained their ordinary lives while adhering to Revan's teachings.<ref name="Revanite Compound" />

The Dark Council viewed the Revanites with contempt for mixing Jedi and Sith teachings. Hence, one of their goals was to root out and destroy the secretive organization before its teachings could spread even further throughout the Empire.

===The return of Revan===
[[File:Order_of_Revan.png|thumb|270px|Rian Darok and Darth Arkous were running the Order, answering only to Revan himself]]
{{Quote|My followers are legion. My ranks grow every hour, as more and more people see the truth of the galaxy. The Emperor could not break me. Even death could not stop me. I will finish what I started. And you will not interfere again.|[[Revan/Legends|Revan]]|<ref name="HC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
In 3637 BBY, during the [[Galactic War]], Revan himself emerged at the head of the Order, having somehow survived his near-fatal battle with Imperial forces on the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]]. However, Revan did not survive intact; due to centuries of torture by the Emperor and the [[Dread Masters]], Revan's mind was split between his light and dark halves, the light half of him becoming a spirit while the dark half retained physical form, possessing strength and cunning but no wisdom. Obsessed with destroying the Emperor, Revan took control of the Revanites to achieve his objective. Under his direction, the Revanites secretly expanded, placing agents into high-ranking positions in both the Empire and Republic. Their agents, [[Darth Arkous]] of the Dark Council and Colonel [[Rian Darok]] of Republic Special Forces, orchestrated simultaneous smash-and-grab operations that were the [[Korriban Incursion]] and the [[assault on Tython]] to recover Rakata technology. With the aid of a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] geneticist named [[Gorima]], they eventually created invincible cyborg supersoldiers to form the base of their [[Infinite Army]]. When strike teams from both galactic powers discovered what they were up to, the two conspirators fled with the research, destroying the underwater base where they created the supersoldiers, thus erasing all evidence that could expose their order. Sith Lord [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Theron Shan]], who had once worked closely with the conspirators, discerned that the Order of Revan planned on annihilating both Empire and Republic, and thus cooperated with each other, along with a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] named [[Jakarro]] to find a way to stop them.

Arkous and Darok fled to [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] and set up their cyborg conscription operation within the [[Temple of the Ancients]]. When their pursuers tracked them down, the subsequent battle resulted in the destruction of the Infinite Army and the two Revanites' deaths. Revan himself soon arrived in-system with a small fleet composed of both Imperial and Republic capital ships. Declaring the loss of the Infinite Army a minor setback, Revan opened fire on the temple in an attempt to kill the interlopers but they escaped via shuttle. Subsequently, the Revanites arranged to deal with the strike team's allies; Jakarro received twelve death sentences on his head, Theron was disavowed by the SIS and Lana was accused of murdering Arkous. The trio then went underground to find a way to expose the order.

The Order later enlisted the services of the [[Nova Blades]] pirate gang to target key hyperspace lanes to force both Republic and Imperial command fleets to the pirate haven of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The plan was for the Revanite fleet to [[Battle of Rishi|attack]] both sides while sleeper agents aboard both fleets sabotaged the ships they were on. Theron, Lana and Jakarro contacted their allies and had them masquerade as a rival pirate gang for the purpose of harassing the Nova Blades to get intel on the Revanites' plan. Once they had information on the trap, the team fought past the Revanites guarding the signal jammer blocking communications in the sky battle. Once the jammer was deactivated, Theron uploaded the identities of Revanite agents to both fleets, resulting in their detainment.

===Revan's defeat===
[[File:Dark_Revan_on_Yavin_4.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Revan makes his last stand against the Coalition alone.]]
With the Revanite infiltrators excised from their fleets and the Revanite flotilla routed, both Republic and Empire agreed to a temporary truce and ally against Revan. Revan took his remaining forces to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where the slumbering Sith Emperor resided after his [[Dromund Kaas operation|defeat]] at the hands of the [[Hero of Tython]]. The Revanites overwhelmed the small number of [[Imperial Guard]]smen stationed at [[Imperial Guard Academy]] and secured the [[Temple of Sacrifice]]. Within the temple was a [[Temple of Sacrifice artifact|device]] capable of consuming all life on the moon to resurrect the Emperor, whom Revan intended to bring back from the brink of death so he could destroy him for good. However, the coalition forces arrived on Yavin 4 and grudgingly worked together to break past the Revanite lines and destroyed the temple device, believing Revan would be unable to defeat the Emperor. 

[[File:Light_Revan_on_Yavin_4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Revan made whole in the Force]]
Ultimately, the elite members of the Coalition confronted Revan on the [[Forgotten Terrace]] and defeated him permanently. The conflict between the Coalition and Revanites had fueled the Emperor's revival, who then departed Yavin 4 without taking a physical form or possessing a body. Revan was then confronted by a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of his other half, who convinced the dark half to release his hold on their physical form and merge, making Revan whole once more as his physical body vanished, leaving only his scarred mask and lightsaber behind. With Revan's defeat, the Revanites were left leaderless and presumably disbanded. As the Republic and Empire departed Yavin 4, they left token forces to watch for any sign of the Revanites if they continued to operate on the moon.

==Organization and philosophy==
{{Quote|We learn to be better, more powerful. Even though the Empire may not publicly support us, we believe in the Empire's ways. Revan mastered the light side and the dark side&mdash;war and peace. We seek to walk the same path.|Dzoun|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Revanites believed that the path to power could not be followed by either Jedi or Sith.<ref name="Master's Secret" /> The idea of rebirth was of particular import to the Order, as they knew of how Revan had been Jedi, Sith, and then reborn as something new when he was betrayed by both. Though the Order of Revan's members were of the Sith Empire, the Order taught that one should not rely only on the dark side: Revan achieved greatness because he relied on both the light and the dark, using the Force as a whole.<ref name="Initiation">{{TORcite|type=general|Initiation|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> The Order was also patriotic; they did not seek to destroy the Empire, but instead change it from within.<ref name="Pilgrimage" />

[[File:Revan_and_his_army-Yavin_4.png|thumb|left|250px|Revan and his army on Yavin 4]]
The Revanites welcomed members of all [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], as they knew how many of Revan's companions and allies had been [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and aliens&mdash;but they believed that Revan had done so because he thought servants were more useful when they were powerful. Because Revan accepted allies from many different walks of life, the Order did the same: the Order included members from every level of the Empire's society, from high-ranking Sith and military officers to commoners and even slaves. The Order also included [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of [[Clan Farr]], who served the Order as a matter of honor, as [[Ceta Farr]] sought to ensure that Revan's name would be remembered.<ref name="Pilgrimage" /> Tari Darkspanner, the Master of the Order, believed that Revan had defeated the Emperor and taken his throne, but she also believed that the Emperor's silence during the Cold War meant that the Dark Council had imprisoned Revan.<ref name="Master's Secret" />

[[File:Revan_and_his_army_Yavin_4.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Revanites soldiers with Revan on Yavin 4]]
Those who sought to join the Order would have to undergo an initiation, in which they would complete various tasks for different members that would test their knowledge of the Order's ideals and their devotion to them.<ref name="Initiation" /> During the initiation, prospective members would visit the Revanite Cave and meditate before the Order's altar there, where many would receive visions of Revan.<ref name="Death and Life" /> Every initiation also included a trial of the past, which would bind the initiate to Revan and help them understand the Order's history.<ref name="Mask of Revan">{{TORcite|type=general|The Mask of Revan|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

When Revan himself directly took control of the Order, the Revanites had expanded to include Republic individuals in their ranks. The Order had forgotten their roots, now fanatically devoted to the former Jedi. Having agents in high-ranking positions in both galactic superpowers enabled the Order to pull strings and covertly falsify information, similar to the [[Star Cabal]]. Despite this, the Republic and Imperial members remained wary of each other, having previously been on opposite sides. The Order's new purpose was to wipe out both Empire and Republic, a goal the Revanites had taken to the point of fanaticism.

==Behind the scenes==
The Order of Revan was first introduced in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which it is the subject of a series of missions on the planet Dromund Kaas. When discussing the fact that she is a woman, Tari Darkspanner claims that Revan's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] is uncertain in their records, a reference to the fact that players can choose to make Revan either male or female as the playable character in BioWare's ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Master's Secret" />
